questions.explanation: Correct order (last to first): Rain falls → Droplets gather as clouds → It condenses into droplets → Vapour rises and cools → Water evaporates.

questions.prompt: Order these steps of cloud formation and rainfall (first to last)
questions.explanation: Correct order (first to last): Water evaporates → Vapour rises and cools → It condenses into droplets → Droplets gather as clouds → Rain falls.
